design: 40 new track/version candidates, all held out; independent genre references where available. No benchmark names or labels enter preprocessing. Inherited source was artist-targeted; this is not an unbiased catalog or an audio-identity validation.

sourceScope.limitation: Partial imported catalog; profiles do not represent complete discographies

build.limitations: Source is inherited artist-targeted data; builder never reads benchmark names. Not an unbiased worldwide catalog. Negative title/version reservoir capped after full mixed-profile computation; house/adjacent title/version groups are not capped. Duration alternatives are retained together.

limitations: UNKNOWN remains reviewable, so retention recall can trivially be 100%; assess automatic recall, review burden, and review precision together.
Only the independently labeled subset supports precision/recall; unreviewed remixes and emerging-style cases are retained but not invented as gold.
Performance batch is catalog-derived and no pressing IDs are supplied. It measures lookup throughput, not classification accuracy or full-catalog coverage.
Same source and metadata queries for both methods; cache, ordering and host load are uncontrolled. Timings are observations, not a latency guarantee.
A single fresh set is small; no rules were retuned after reading its results.
